mapper.sql: id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, gmt_created, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 0, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE address SET is_default = 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, gmt_created DESC
SELECT FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
